### CNN hyperparameter search

<!-- Task 5 (CNN part): coarse then refined grid search over learning rate, dropout and number of filters for the lecture model structure. 4-fold cross-validation over sessions 1-4. Session 5 is the test set and is only used once, for the selected combination. -->

```{r}
#| label: cnn-hpo-cache

# Training results are saved to three files and reused:
#   the coarse grid, the refined grid, and the test predictions of the selected combination.
# The training chunks below only run when their file is missing.
# After changing any of the training code, delete the files and render again.
cnn_hpo_coarse_file <- "results/cnn_hpo_coarse.rds"
cnn_hpo_refined_file <- "results/cnn_hpo_refined.rds"
cnn_hpo_test_file <- "results/cnn_hpo_test.rds"
cnn_hpo_run_coarse <- !file.exists(cnn_hpo_coarse_file)
cnn_hpo_run_refined <- !file.exists(cnn_hpo_refined_file)
cnn_hpo_run_test <- !file.exists(cnn_hpo_test_file)
cnn_hpo_run_any <- cnn_hpo_run_coarse || cnn_hpo_run_refined || cnn_hpo_run_test
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-hpo-preprocess
#| eval: !expr cnn_hpo_run_any

# Scale pixel values to 0,1
x <- handwriting$images / 255

y <- to_categorical(handwriting$metadata$person_id - 1, 20) #needs classes numbered from 0
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-hpo-define
#| eval: !expr cnn_hpo_run_any

# Hyper-params:
# the number of filters in both convolution layers, the dropout rate and the learning rate
build_model <- function(filters, dropout, learning_rate) {
  input <- layer_input(shape = c(28, 28, 1))

  output <- input %>%
    layer_conv_2d(filters = filters, kernel_size = c(3,3)) %>%
    layer_activation('relu') %>%
    layer_dropout(rate = dropout) %>%
    layer_conv_2d(filters = filters, kernel_size = c(3,3), activation = "relu") %>%
    layer_max_pooling_2d(pool_size = c(2, 2)) %>%
    layer_flatten() %>%
    layer_dense(units = 20, activation = 'softmax')

  model <- keras_model(inputs = input, outputs = output)

  model %>% compile(
    loss = 'categorical_crossentropy',
    optimizer = optimizer_adam(learning_rate = learning_rate),
    metrics = c('accuracy'),
  )

  model
}

# 4-fold cross-validation by session over sessions 1-4 for every row of a grid.
# No early stopping: every combination trains for the same number of epochs and the
# validation accuracy is recorded after each epoch (batch size is fixed at 128).
cv_grid <- function(grid, epochs) {
  grid_history <- list()

  for (i in 1:nrow(grid)) {
    for (fold in 1:4) {
      train_id <- which(handwriting$metadata$session <= 4 & handwriting$metadata$session != fold)
      val_id <- which(handwriting$metadata$session == fold)

      set_random_seed(67)
      model <- build_model(grid$filters[i], grid$dropout[i], grid$learning_rate[i])

      history <- model %>% fit(
        x[train_id,,,,drop = FALSE], y[train_id,],
        epochs = epochs, batch_size = 128,
        validation_data = list(x[val_id,,,,drop = FALSE], y[val_id,]), shuffle = TRUE,
        verbose = 0
      )

      grid_history[[paste(i, fold)]] <- tibble(
        learning_rate = grid$learning_rate[i], dropout = grid$dropout[i], filters = grid$filters[i],
        fold = fold, epoch = 1:epochs,
        train = history$metrics$accuracy,
        validation = history$metrics$val_accuracy)
    }
  }

  bind_rows(grid_history)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-hpo-summarise

# For every combination: the cross-validated accuracy (mean over the four folds) at each epoch,
# the best epoch, and the earliest epoch within one standard error of the best (as in lambda.1se)
summarise_grid <- function(grid_history) {
  grid_history %>%
    group_by(learning_rate, dropout, filters, epoch) %>%
    summarise(cv_accuracy = mean(validation), cv_se = sd(validation) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
    mutate(best_epoch = epoch[which.max(cv_accuracy)],
           best_accuracy = max(cv_accuracy),
           best_se = cv_se[which.max(cv_accuracy)]) %>%
    filter(cv_accuracy >= best_accuracy - best_se) %>%
    slice_min(epoch, n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(learning_rate, dropout, filters, best_epoch, best_accuracy, best_se,
           epoch_1se = epoch, accuracy_1se = cv_accuracy) %>%
    arrange(desc(best_accuracy))
}

# Learning rate on the x axis, one line per dropout rate, one panel per number of filters
plot_grid <- function(grid_summary) {
  ggplot(grid_summary, aes(x = learning_rate, y = best_accuracy, colour = factor(dropout))) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = unique(grid_summary$learning_rate)) +
    facet_wrap(~ filters, labeller = labeller(filters = function(f) paste("filters:", f))) +
    labs(x = "Learning rate", y = "Accuracy (cross-validation)", colour = "Dropout rate") +
    theme(legend.position = "top", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-hpo-coarse
#| eval: !expr cnn_hpo_run_coarse

# Coarse grid: 3 x 3 x 3 = 27 combinations, 20 epochs each
cnn_hpo_coarse_grid <- expand_grid(learning_rate = c(0.0001, 0.001, 0.01),
                                   dropout = c(0, 0.2, 0.5),
                                   filters = c(8, 16, 32))

dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(cv_grid(cnn_hpo_coarse_grid, epochs = 20), cnn_hpo_coarse_file)
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-hpo-coarse-results

cnn_hpo_coarse <- summarise_grid(readRDS(cnn_hpo_coarse_file))
cnn_hpo_coarse
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-hpo-coarse-plot

plot_grid(cnn_hpo_coarse)
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-hpo-refined
#| eval: !expr cnn_hpo_run_refined

# Refined grid, centred on the best region of the coarse grid:
#   the lowest learning rate and the highest dropout rate did best, so both are extended past the coarse grid;
#   the number of filters made no consistent difference, so it is fixed at the 16 used in the lecture model.
# Lower learning rates need longer to train, so each combination gets 40 epochs.
cnn_hpo_refined_grid <- expand_grid(learning_rate = c(0.00003, 0.0001, 0.0003),
                                    dropout = c(0.5, 0.65, 0.8),
                                    filters = 16)

saveRDS(cv_grid(cnn_hpo_refined_grid, epochs = 40), cnn_hpo_refined_file)
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-hpo-refined-results

cnn_hpo_refined <- summarise_grid(readRDS(cnn_hpo_refined_file))
cnn_hpo_refined
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-hpo-refined-plot

plot_grid(cnn_hpo_refined)
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-hpo-selected

# Best cross-validated combination across both grids, trained for its one-standard-error number of epochs
cnn_hpo_selected <- bind_rows(coarse = cnn_hpo_coarse, refined = cnn_hpo_refined, .id = "grid") %>%
  slice_max(best_accuracy, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
cnn_hpo_selected
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-hpo-selected-curve

# Cross-validated accuracy (+/- one standard error) by epoch for the selected combination.
# Dashed line: best epoch. Solid line: earliest epoch within one standard error of the best.
readRDS(if (cnn_hpo_selected$grid == "coarse") cnn_hpo_coarse_file else cnn_hpo_refined_file) %>%
  semi_join(cnn_hpo_selected, by = c("learning_rate", "dropout", "filters")) %>%
  group_by(epoch) %>%
  summarise(cv_accuracy = mean(validation), cv_se = sd(validation) / sqrt(n())) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = epoch, y = cv_accuracy)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = cv_accuracy - cv_se, ymax = cv_accuracy + cv_se), colour = "grey60", width = 0.3) +
  geom_point(colour = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = cnn_hpo_selected$best_epoch, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = cnn_hpo_selected$epoch_1se) +
  labs(y = "Accuracy (cross-validation)")
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-hpo-test
#| eval: !expr cnn_hpo_run_test

# Train the selected combination on sessions 1-4, then predict the test session once
train_id <- which(handwriting$metadata$session <= 4)
test_id <- which(handwriting$metadata$session == 5)

set_random_seed(67)
model <- build_model(cnn_hpo_selected$filters, cnn_hpo_selected$dropout, cnn_hpo_selected$learning_rate)

model %>% fit(
  x[train_id,,,,drop = FALSE], y[train_id,],
  epochs = cnn_hpo_selected$epoch_1se, batch_size = 128,
  shuffle = TRUE, verbose = 0
)

y_test_hat <- model %>% predict(x[test_id,,,,drop = FALSE], verbose = 0) %>% op_argmax(axis = 2) %>% as.numeric()

saveRDS(as_tibble(handwriting$metadata[test_id,]) %>% mutate(predicted = y_test_hat), cnn_hpo_test_file)
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-hpo-test-accuracy

cnn_hpo_test <- readRDS(cnn_hpo_test_file)

# Test accuracy of the selected combination (for discussion only: nothing is chosen from this)
cnn_hpo_test %>%
  summarise(n = n(), accuracy = mean(person_id == predicted))
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-hpo-test-by-digit

cnn_hpo_test %>%
  group_by(digit) %>%
  summarise(accuracy = mean(person_id == predicted)) %>%
  arrange(desc(accuracy))
```
